extraction_note: The 10-node upscale sub-graph is nested inside definitions.subgraphs['Model upscale'] (NOT at top level of the UI-format JSON). _extract_upscale_subgraph() reads the UI-format JSON, locates the 'Model upscale' subgraph, converts its 10 nodes to API format, and re-homes them with their original VRGDG node ids. If the named subgraph is absent, it falls back to top-level `nodes` (legacy format).

220.adaptation: av_latent input rewired from VRGDG subgraph input slot 7 (-10) to our LTXVConcatAVLatent (node 54). Splits our joint AV latent into video (slot 0) + audio (slot 1); audio feeds ConcatAV(190) (D-09).

222.adaptation: positive/negative rewired to our LTXVConditioning (node 15); latent from SeparateAV(220) video output. Crops guide frames before upscale (D-08).

192.adaptation: upscale_model rewired to our LatentUpscaleModelLoader (node 60); vae to our VAELoader (node 31); samples from CropGuides(222). 2x spatial conv net.

221.adaptation: vae from node 31; image from our LoadImage(14, portrait); latent from Upsampler(192). strength FORCED 1.0, bypass FORCED False (D-07). Never LTXVImgToVideoConditionOnly.

190.adaptation: video_latent from Inplace(221); audio_latent from SeparateAV(220) audio output. Recombines AV latent before sampler (D-09).

207.adaptation: noise/guider/sampler/sigmas/latent_image wired within subgraph. Output (slot 0) feeds our decode-side SeparateAV(230).

188.adaptation: cfg FORCED LTX2_DEFAULT_CFG (1.0, D-06); model from UnetLoaderGGUF(1); positive/negative from CropGuides(222).

subgraph_input_slot_map.6: FORCED False (bypass) -- not wired from subgraph input
subgraph_input_slot_map.7: LTXVConcatAVLatent(54) av_latent (our constructed joint AV latent)
